name: Plugin Manager G2
author: sd88me
summary: Browse this catalog and install, update and remove plugins on the MPC itself, with rollback if an install fails. A VST with its own screen (light or dark), five plugins per page with thumbnails, local zips and registering folders MPC does not list. Gen2 (aarch64) first; a fork of poloq's MIT mpc-vst-manager.
